recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一個緊密聚集的細胞團呈強烈棕色膜/胞質染色，周圍另有散在的梭形陽性細胞，其他造血細胞陰性；這種多灶緻密聚集型態符合系統性肥大細胞增生症的主要診斷標準（標記未標示，推測為 tryptase 或 CD117）。
features: Dense compact aggregate of strongly immunoreactive cells (well over 15 cells)
Strong cytoplasmic/membranous brown staining with round to spindled cell shapes
Scattered individual spindle-shaped positive cells in adjacent interstitium
Surrounding hematopoietic cells and fat largely negative
Aggregate located between fat spaces at low power
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow biopsy (DAB; marker not specified, likely a mast cell marker such as tryptase or CD117) highlights a large, dense, compact aggregate of positive cells, with additional scattered spindle-shaped positive cells in the interstitium. The remaining hematopoietic elements are negative. A compact aggregate of more than 15 mast cells fulfills the major WHO criterion; findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis, with CD25/CD2 aberrancy and KIT D816V testing recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are scattered singly and round, without compact aggregates of >15 cells, and are CD25-negative.
These show increased blasts with tryptase expression but no compact spindled aggregates meeting SM criteria and lack KIT D816V typically.
Lymphoid aggregates are tryptase/CD117-negative and CD3/CD20-positive.

stain: IHC: marker not specified (likely tryptase/CD117), DAB
